info.title: HEXDailyData API reference
info.description:
Read-only HEX data for apps, scripts and dashboards. The normal Daily/Live contract is version daily-product-1; provider/view selectors have retired. Accepted examples are saved historical data; other backend examples are labelled synthetic. No public deployment or current data claim.

Amounts are precise numeric strings or null. Never convert authoritative magnitudes to binary floating point. Hearts are10^-8 HEX; payoutStakeShares are raw shares, distinct from snapshot totalTshares. Product contractDay is computed from dateUtc, not the legacy source index.

Daily records describe history, not live freshness. Latest response groups carry original observedAtUtc/age/status. servedAtUtc is only response time. Saved base plus observed updates is not a complete current inventory.

Cross-field day/chain/ratio/cursor/coverage refinements are also enforced at runtime; addresses normalize to lowercase. No production qualification implied.

servers.description: Current origin; no hosted service is implied.

get.description:
Latest qualified readings with their actual observation ages.

Saved records remain stale; unqualified current feeds remain null. servedAtUtc is not an observation timestamp.

A supplied invalid/revoked/duplicate API key never falls back to public access. Successful paid GET/HEAD/304 uses the original allowance hold; failures/cancellation release it. HTTP/input bounds and429backoff remain. No arbitrary SQL or RPC access.

No Authorization means bounded public JSON, even with a session. Public admission remains120requests/minute and8active per socket source. Complete CSV has separate authorization and is unmetered against JSON allowance.

Latest Daily context and independently aged latest readings.

Uses the same admitted product as Daily and Live. A historical reference quote is never a live spot quote.

methods: Daily recorded snapshots use their original UTC record date and latest whole observation on that date; not verified closing or measurement time. No carry-forward.
Calendar changes use consecutive selected dates only. Holder-index and missing-end/GA counts retain their proxy definitions.

Daily payouts use independently pinned contract-day totals; snapshot T-shares are not the payout denominator. Rates are exact rational calculation displayed half-up to 18 places; zero shares mean null.

HEX reference price: admitted early V3, otherwise eligible V2; admitted PulseChain in its separate domain. Explicitly conflicted/excluded primary quotes never fall back. No close/spot/ATH/ROI or cross-era returns.
Ethereum-origin prices stop at the conservative 2022 cap; this is not a fork date. The unqualified 2023 gap remains. Live markets, liquidity and gas are separate meanings.

x-essentials.exact: Amounts are precise numeric strings or null. Never convert authoritative magnitudes to binary floating point. Hearts are10^-8 HEX; payoutStakeShares are raw shares, distinct from snapshot totalTshares. Product contractDay is computed from dateUtc, not the legacy source index.
x-essentials.freshness: Daily records describe history, not live freshness. Latest response groups carry original observedAtUtc/age/status. servedAtUtc is only response time. Saved base plus observed updates is not a complete current inventory.
x-essentials.indexed: Opaque cursors bind route, product, selection and access context and expire after60seconds. Keep filters unchanged and restart on409; users do not choose a dataset version.
x-essentials.hds: Historical material is an internal bootstrap input, not a source selector or alternate product. Provider choices are retired. One selected Daily response preserves snapshot/ledger/reference-price meanings and explicit gaps.
x-essentials.address: Address responses preserve original reported records and coherent paired holder/stake versions. Absence is not zero; negative bookkeeping anomalies are not ordinary balances.
x-essentials.errors: A supplied invalid/revoked/duplicate API key never falls back to public access. Successful paid GET/HEAD/304 uses the original allowance hold; failures/cancellation release it. HTTP/input bounds and429backoff remain. No arbitrary SQL or RPC access.
x-essentials.downloads: Complete daily CSV is the actual selected projection. Existing purchased-access authorization, private caching and reader admission remain. Real account/payment backend and redistribution are not qualified by this offline task.
x-essentials.access: No Authorization means bounded public JSON, even with a session. Public admission remains120requests/minute and8active per socket source. Complete CSV has separate authorization and is unmetered against JSON allowance.
x-essentials.caching: Paid responses use private,no-store. Public JSON uses no-cache,must-revalidate. ETags and HEAD/304 never bypass authorization. Daily ETags bind selection/product/access; Live also changes with age/status.
